verdict.rationale: Okta's own event hooks fire outbound HTTPS calls to a URL you specify when chosen events occur in your org (okta-docs-4, okta-docs-17). That is a first-party event-triggered mechanism, but the only automatic action evidenced is the callback itself: any further work happens in an external endpoint you must build and host. missing for 10: a native rule or condition builder (no workflow or no-code automation engine is evidenced), built-in actions that run inside Okta, depth on event filtering and conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
